units.rawText: No. 18: The Moon. Oh moon that is lost and beset with difficulty, what is the question you wish to ask of the cards?
units.displayText: No. 18: The Moon. Oh moon that is lost and beset with difficulty, what is the question you wish to ask of the cards?

spans.text: No. 18: The Moon. Oh moon that is lost and beset with difficulty, what is the question you wish to ask of the cards?

units.rawText: ...You want to know how to regain your fortune-telling ability, don't you?
units.displayText: ...You want to know how to regain your fortune-telling ability, don't you?

spans.text: ...You want to know how to regain your fortune-telling ability, don't you?

units.rawText: Yes, please.
units.displayText: Yes, please.

spans.text: Yes, please.

units.rawText: Your question is vague and too broad in scope... Even if the cards can show you the way, you will still have to walk it yourself.
units.displayText: Your question is vague and too broad in scope... Even if the cards can show you the way, you will still have to walk it yourself.

spans.text: Your question is vague and too broad in scope... Even if the cards can show you the way, you will still have to walk it yourself.

units.rawText: I know that, so hurry up.

spans.text: After some pestering by Luna, Yelena shuffles the deck and then begins to lay them out on the center of the table.

units.rawText: This first card will point the way for you... It will lead you to the way to recover your powers.
units.displayText: This first card will point the way for you... It will lead you to the way to recover your powers.

spans.text: This first card will point the way for you... It will lead you to the way to recover your powers.

units.rawText: Hold on... Can we reveal it together?
units.displayText: Hold on... Can we reveal it together?

spans.text: Hold on... Can we reveal it together?

units.rawText: Luna's hand touches the back of Yelena's. The impatient look on her face suggests how desperately she wants to know the answer.

units.rawText: Huh? Now this is a surprising outcome...
units.displayText: Huh? Now this is a surprising outcome...

spans.text: Huh? Now this is a surprising outcome...

units.rawText: The card she reveals depicts a broad, clear sky, a scene full of hope, and in the middle of it is a massive sun.
units.displayText: The card she reveals depicts a broad, clear sky, a scene full of hope, and in the middle of it is a massive sun.

spans.text: The card she reveals depicts a broad, clear sky, a scene full of hope, and in the middle of it is a massive sun.

units.rawText: No. 19, The Sun, dealt upright. Unlike The Moon, it represents hope and success. If you seek an outcome, then there is no better card than this.
units.displayText: No. 19, The Sun, dealt upright. Unlike The Moon, it represents hope and success. If you seek an outcome, then there is no better card than this.

spans.text: No. 19, The Sun, dealt upright. Unlike The Moon, it represents hope and success. If you seek an outcome, then there is no better card than this.

units.rawText: But I want a clue... Which means we'll need to try and understand what it means.
units.displayText: But I want a clue... Which means we'll need to try and understand what it means.

units.displayText: Luna rests her chin in her hands and stares at the card.

spans.text: Luna rests her chin in her hands and stares at the card.

units.rawText: Apart from success and hope... It often symbolizes a wisdom that surpasses The Hermit.
units.displayText: Apart from success and hope... It often symbolizes a wisdom that surpasses The Hermit.

spans.text: Apart from success and hope... It often symbolizes a wisdom that surpasses The Hermit.

units.rawText: A brilliant mind that can illuminate the land... that's why they call it The Sun. We're in Magrasea now... so the person in Magrasea who fits that description is...

units.rawText: That's right... Anna asked me to keep running my fortune-telling program. Ah! I see! That's got to be it!
units.displayText: That's right... Anna asked me to keep running my fortune-telling program. Ah! I see! That's got to be it!

spans.text: That's right... Anna asked me to keep running my fortune-telling program. Ah! I see! That's got to be it!

units.displayText: Luna exclaims in delight and springs up before rushing out of the Recreation Area.

spans.text: Luna exclaims in delight and springs up before rushing out of the Recreation Area.

units.rawText: I've got it! Thank you, Yelena!
units.displayText: I've got it! Thank you, Yelena!

spans.text: I've got it! Thank you, Yelena!

units.rawText: Lend me this card for a bit!
units.displayText: Lend me this card for a bit!

spans.text: Lend me this card for a bit!

units.rawText: Yelena shakes her head as she watches Luna and her voice trail off into the distance.
units.displayText: Yelena shakes her head as she watches Luna and her voice trail off into the distance.

spans.text: Yelena shakes her head as she watches Luna and her voice trail off into the distance.

units.rawText: You're the one who asked me to do a reading, yet you ended up interpreting the cards on your own... Still, you wouldn't be Luna if you didn't.

units.displayText: Yelena restacks the deck. She looks at it and its one missing card and smiles.

units.rawText: Still, given the direction she was headed, and the reading she just did... Oh dear, all the best, Professor.
